privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what flipword stores about you, why, and what you can do about it. We collect only what the app needs to work. We don't sell your data, show ads, or use analytics or tracking tools.

who.title: Who is responsible
who.body: The operator named above is the controller of your personal data under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Write to the contact address above with any question about your data or this policy.

data.title: What we store
data.body:
Account: when you sign in with Google or Facebook we receive and store your name, email address, a link to your profile picture and your account ID with that provider. We never see your password and never post anything on your behalf.

Your content: decks, words, example sentences, photos you add, flags, settings (such as your languages, daily limits and time zone), study and game history, achievements, and the names of access tokens you create for AI assistants (only a hash of each token is stored).

Technical data: for each sign-in session we store the IP address and browser it was started from, to keep your account secure. Our hosting provider also keeps short-lived request logs, including IP addresses, to operate and protect the service.

Reports: if you report a public deck, we store the report together with your account so we can follow up.

purposes.title: Why we use it
purposes.body: We use your data to provide flipword to you: to sign you in, store and schedule your cards, and show your progress (GDPR Art. 6(1)(b), performance of our agreement with you). Session and log data are used to keep the service secure and prevent abuse, which is our legitimate interest (Art. 6(1)(f)). We don't use your data for advertising or profiling, and we don't make automated decisions about you.

sharing.title: Who else processes it
sharing.body:
Cloudflare hosts flipword for us: its servers, database, photo storage and logs. Cloudflare processes the data on our behalf under its data processing agreement, which also covers transfers outside the EU, for example to the United States.

Google or Meta (Facebook) handle sign-in when you choose them. Their own privacy policies apply to what happens on their side.

We don't sell your data or share it with anyone else, unless the law requires us to.

publicDecks.title: Public decks
publicDecks.body: Decks are private unless you make them public. Every signed-in user can see a public deck's name, description and words (front, back and example) and your first name, and can copy the deck. Photos, flags and your progress are never shown. Making a deck private again hides it immediately, but copies other people have already made stay theirs.

cookies.title: Cookies and local storage
cookies.body: flipword sets only the cookies it needs to keep you signed in. It also saves a few preferences, such as your theme and interface language, in your browser's local storage, and caches the app so it loads quickly and can be installed. None of this is used for tracking, which is why there's no cookie banner.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.body: We keep your data for as long as you have an account. Sign-in sessions end after 7 days without use. When you delete your account, your profile, decks, words, photos, history, tokens and reports are deleted immediately; database backups that still contain them are overwritten within 30 days. Hosting logs are kept for a few days.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You can download your data at any time (Settings → Download my data), correct it by editing it in the app, and delete it (Settings → Delete account). You can also ask us for a copy of your data, to restrict or stop processing, or anything else about your data, at the contact address above. If you live in the EU/EEA or the UK, you can also complain to your local data protection authority.

deletion.title: Deleting your data
deletion.body:
Go to Settings → Delete account. This deletes your account and everything in it straight away, including photos, and can't be undone.

Removing flipword from your Google or Facebook settings only stops future sign-ins; it doesn't delete your flipword data, so delete your account here first. If you can no longer sign in, email the contact address above from the address on your account and we'll delete it for you.

security.title: Security
security.body: All connections are encrypted (HTTPS). Photos are only visible to you. Access tokens are shown once, stored only as a hash and can be revoked in Settings at any time.

children.title: Children
children.body: flipword isn't intended for anyone under 16. If you believe a child has created an account, contact us and we'll delete it.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
changes.body: When this policy changes we'll update the date at the top. For significant changes we'll give notice before they take effect.

terms.title: Terms of service
terms.intro: These terms apply when you use flipword. By signing in you agree to them. Please read them together with the privacy policy.

account.title: Your account
account.body: You sign in with a Google or Facebook account, and you must be at least 16. You're responsible for what happens under your account, including through access tokens you create for AI assistants, so keep them safe.

content.title: Your content
content.body: Your decks, words and photos remain yours. You allow us to store, process and display them as needed to run flipword for you. Only upload what you have the right to use.

publicDecks.title: Public decks
publicDecks.body: When you make a deck public, you allow other flipword users to view it and make their own copies for personal learning, and you allow us to show it in Discover. You can make it private again at any time; copies already made aren't affected.

rules.title: Rules
rules.body: Don't use flipword to upload or share content that is illegal, infringes someone else's rights (such as copyrighted material you may not share), harasses or threatens people, is sexually explicit, or is spam. Don't try to break, overload or get around the limits or security of the service, or to access other people's data.

reports.title: Reporting content
reports.body: Every public deck has a Report button for content that breaks these rules or the law; you can also write to the contact address above. We review reports and may make a deck private, remove content or suspend accounts that break these terms. When we do, we tell the affected user why, unless the law prevents it.

availability.title: Availability
availability.body: flipword is free and provided as it is. We work to keep it running and your data safe, but we can't promise it will always be available or free of errors. Keep your own copies of anything important — you can export decks as CSV and download all your data at any time.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: As far as the law allows, we aren't liable for indirect losses, or for losses caused by events outside our reasonable control. Nothing in these terms limits liability that can't legally be limited, or your rights as a consumer.

ending.title: Ending your use
ending.body: You can stop using flipword and delete your account at any time in Settings. We may suspend or close accounts that seriously or repeatedly break these terms.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
changes.body: We may update these terms. For significant changes we'll give notice before they take effect; if you keep using flipword after that, the new terms apply.

games.title: Games
games.subtitle: Practise your words in different ways. Games don't change your review schedule, but every answer counts towards each word's progress.
games.notEnoughTitle: Not enough cards for this game

match.name: Match
match.description: Pair each word with its meaning against the clock.
match.howTo: Tap a word, then its meaning. Clear the board as fast as you can — every wrong pair adds a second.

quiz.name: Quiz
quiz.howTo: Pick the right meaning for a word, or the right word for a meaning. Use the number keys 1–4.

truefalse.name: True or false
truefalse.description: A 60-second speed round. Streaks multiply your points.
truefalse.howTo: Does the meaning belong to the word? Answer as many as you can in 60 seconds. Use ← for false and → for true.

spell.name: Spell it
spell.description: See the meaning, then type the word.
spell.howTo: Type the word for each meaning. Accents count. Tap Listen if you'd like to hear it first.

scramble.name: Unscramble
scramble.description: Rebuild the word from its shuffled letters.
scramble.howTo: Tap the letters (or type them) in the right order. Backspace removes a letter. Each hint costs {{cost}} points.
scramble.notQuite: Not quite — remove letters and try again.

flags.label: Flag
flags.settingsDescription: Name your flags to give them meaning, e.g. “Tricky” or “Verbs”. Empty names use the colour.

mcp.title: Connect an AI assistant
mcp.description: Let Claude or another MCP-capable assistant create decks and add, edit or delete words for you. Each assistant gets its own token, which you can revoke at any time.
mcp.serverUrlHint: Streamable HTTP endpoint. Requires a token from below.
mcp.tokenNamePlaceholder: e.g. Claude Desktop on my laptop
mcp.createdHint: Copy it now — it won't be shown again. Anyone with this token can read and change your decks.

instructions.claude-desktop: Add this to claude_desktop_config.json (Settings → Developer → Edit Config), then restart Claude Desktop. Requires Node.js.

mcp.revokeDescription: Assistants using it will lose access immediately.

discover.title: Discover decks
discover.subtitle: Find decks other learners have shared and add a copy to your own.
discover.emptyDescription: When people make a deck public it shows up here. Share one of yours from its page.

shared.addHint: You get your own private copy with every word new. Changes the author makes later don't reach your copy.
shared.ownPrivate: This is your deck. It's private, so only you can open this page.
shared.empty: This deck has no words yet.
shared.notFoundDescription: This deck is private or no longer exists.

landing.title: Vocabulary that stays learned.
landing.subtitle: flipword shows each word just before you'd forget it. Study a few minutes a day, and the gaps between reviews grow from minutes to months.

demo.label: Try a flashcard
demo.hint: Try it: tap the card, then rate how well you knew it.
demo.footnote: Each button shows when the word comes back. These are real numbers from the scheduler.

how.title: Reviews spread out as you remember
how.body: Answer Good every time and a new word comes back after 10 minutes, then in a couple of days, then weeks and months later. Press Again and it starts over with short steps. The scheduler is FSRS, the open-source algorithm also built into Anki, aiming for {{retention}} recall by default.
how.chartTitle: One word, answered Good every time

import.title: Import your decks
import.body: Anki packages (.apkg), CSV and TSV files, Quizlet exports. Files are read in your browser.

typing.title: Type the answer
typing.body: Type the word instead of flipping. Right, wrong and missing letters are marked.

media.title: Photos and audio
media.body: Add a photo to any word and hear it spoken in the language you're learning.

achievements.title: Streaks and achievements
achievements.body: Milestones for days in a row, words learned, reviews and games played.

assistant.title: Works with your AI assistant
assistant.body: Connect Claude, Cursor or another MCP client and ask it to add 30 words about cooking.

install.title: Install it like an app
install.body: Add it to your home screen or dock. Light and dark themes included.

games.title_one: {{count}} game for a change of pace
games.title_other: {{count}} games for a change of pace
games.body: Games mix recognition and recall. They never touch your review schedule, but every answer counts toward a word's progress.

cta.body: Sign in, pick the language you're learning, and add words by hand or import a deck you already have.
